name: Gem of Seeing
summary: A gem that grants Truesight when you peer through it, using charges.

stats.effect:
This gem has 3 charges. As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can expend 1 charge. For the next 10 minutes, you have {ref:glossary/truesight} out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

The gem regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.
